transcript: Speaker A: मेरा निकम्मा पति मुझे छोड़ के चला गया। पांच बच्चों के साथ ट्रेन में अकेला छोड़ गया। मेरा नाम सायरा है, लखनऊ से हूँ। [My useless husband abandoned me, leaving me alone on a train with five children. My name is Saira, and I am from Lucknow.] ... [She explains how she was abandoned, struggled to find a job due to lack of English, and was rejected at interviews.] ... फिर इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप का ऐड आया, ₹1 का ट्रायल। [Then I saw an ad for the English Seekho app with a 1-rupee trial.] ... मैंने ऐप से इंग्लिश सीखी, नौकरी पाई और आज मेरी सैलरी ₹38,000 है। [I learned English from the app, got a job, and today my salary is 38,000 rupees.] ... नीचे दिए बटन पर क्लिक करो और इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [Click the button below and download the English Seekho app.]
on_screen_text: English Seekho. INSTALL NOW. [Disclaimer text explaining that the app is not affiliated with any government authority and results may vary.]
summary: A woman narrates her struggle of being abandoned by her husband with five children and facing job rejections due to her lack of English. She downloads the English Seekho app for a 1-rupee trial, improves her English using the AI coach, and secures a well-paying job. She urges other struggling women to download the app and become independent.
